verdict.rationale: SES doesn't offer native webhooks, but it can publish sending/receiving events (bounces, complaints, deliveries) to Amazon SNS, EventBridge, or other AWS services, and SNS topics support HTTP/HTTPS endpoint subscriptions that function as webhook-style callbacks — enabling an event-driven integration pattern rather than polling. This is an AWS-native workaround rather than a first-class 'subscribe via webhook' feature. Missing for 10: a dedicated built-in webhook configuration/URL field, first-party docs explicitly calling it 'webhooks', and independent confirmation of ease-of-use for AI-native/agentic consumption.
